description: Close an active trace session, serialize the captured steps, upload to TrustModel cloud storage, and auto-create an agentic evaluation run. Returns both a file_path (for record-keeping / retry) and an evaluation_run_id that can be polled with trustmodel_score_agent.

actual_outcome.description: Optional description of what actually happened.

final_response.description: The final user-facing answer from the agent.

goal.description: Override `goal` if the agent learned more at runtime.

goal_achieved.description: Whether the agent achieved its goal.

success.description: Whether the run is considered successful overall.

total_duration_ms.description: Total execution time in ms. If omitted, computed from step durations.

name: trustmodel_trace_finalize
